verdict.rationale: Agora's docs say a client can join a live streaming channel as an audience member and play or process the streams it subscribes to, which implies a non-publishing consumer such as an agent. Raw audio frame observation is also documented. The pack never shows subscribing to just one track (for example audio-only from one host) or confirms the publisher needs no changes. Missing for 10: explicit per-track selective subscription docs, confirmation that publishers are untouched, an agent-specific subscription example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes

citations.quote: You either directly play the subscribed streams or process incoming data for other purposes such as recording or capturing screenshots.
In a live streaming channel, users have two client roles: *host* and *audience*.
After you call `registerAudioFrameObserver`, you can obtain the raw audio data
